title: Long-Range Correlation of the Sine$_β$ point Process
summary: We study the correlations of the celebrated Sine$_β$ point process. This point process arises as the bulk scaling limit of $β$-ensembles and has a geometric description through the Brownian carousel, as shown by Valkó and Virág (2009). We establish that the averaged $k$-point truncated correlation functions decay polynomially in the limit of large separation. We show that the decay exponent is of order $1/β$ for large $β$.
